> **Not yet written (2026-08-04).** This page will document where keys live and how funding and spending actions gate on human approval. Today the accurate path is the [quickstart](/docs/build/quickstart), which shows the current custody shape end to end.

An agent driving the journey never accepts a raw private key into its context — that rule applies today, not later.

Intended sections:

- Keys stay in the machine-local keystore.
- An agent driving the journey does not relax custody.
- Funding and spending actions gate on human approval.
- Never accept a raw private key into an agent's context.
